# Database Compliance & Schema Purge Checklist: Purge Legacy Database and Strict DBML Alignment

**Purpose**: Rigorous compliance audit validating the quality, completeness, and clarity of requirements for the strict DBML database purge
**Created**: 2026-10-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Schema Purge & DBML Fidelity Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact 7 authorized DBML tables explicitly enumerated without ambiguity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all 8 legacy tables targeted for deletion explicitly named in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the deletion sequence of legacy tables defined to prevent foreign key constraint violations? [Clarity, Plan §Phase 0]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define the fate of the obsolete `hashed_password` column on `users`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Are all allowed values of the three enumerated types (`user_role`, `asset_status`, `maintenance_type`) explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the requirement for zero residual tables post-migration objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Data Model & Constraint Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK007 Are the foreign key deletion policies (CASCADE, RESTRICT, SET NULL) specified for all relationships? [Completeness, Data Model]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the handling of NULL values in the unique constraint `uq_locations_physical_space` explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Data Model]
- [ ] CHK009 Are check constraint boundaries for financial and numerical fields (`residual_value_rate`, `purchase_cost`, `cost`) documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the requirement for JSONB structured specifications on `assets` consistent with PostgreSQL dialect standards? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements for mandatory audit fields (`changed_by_id`, `changed_at`, `registered_by_id`) consistently defined across history tables? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012]

## API & Interface Deprecation Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for the retirement or removal of obsolete routes (`/api/v1/equipments`, `/api/v1/catalogs`)? [Coverage, Plan §Research Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the expected HTTP status code specified when clients attempt to access retired legacy routes? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the response payload structures for canonical asset endpoints fully documented in the contracts? [Completeness, Contracts §4]
- [ ] CHK015 Are authentication payload requirements consistent with the purged `users` table without legacy field leakage? [Consistency, Contracts §1, Spec §FR-003]

## Constitutional & Quality Gate Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Is the requirement for 100% line and branch test coverage explicitly maintained across all modified modules? [Measurability, Plan §Constitution Check, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the plan document compliance with the ban on raw SQL for all migration and repository updates? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK018 Are database migration requirements specified to be forward-idempotent under Alembic? [Clarity, Plan §Constitution Check, Plan §Phase 0]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the architectural boundary strictly preserved so that domain models do not import transport libraries? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for assets having no assigned custodian user? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Data Model]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for physical locations that have no room number specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for handling attempt to delete a category or location that contains active assets? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the behavior specified when renumbering an asset whose proposed new number conflicts with an existing asset? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK024 Are execution time constraints for the database cleanup migration quantitatively bounded? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially starting from CHK001 for rigorous traceability
